text.tspan: MASS SWEEP
@unhappychoice blitzes 15 repos with deps updates in a single week
TYPO CRIMES
@unhappychoice hunts down `type_synomym` — a typo hiding in a grammar for years
LINE MASSACRE
@unhappychoice deletes 4,755 lines in cycle-flyer. Lockfile did not survive.
APPROVED AGAIN
@unhappychoice approves 39 PRs this week. Rubber stamp reportedly worn thin.
WINDOWS NOW
@unhappychoice submits gittype to winget-pkgs. Windows users rejoice.
NODE UPGRADE
@unhappychoice forces CI off Node 20 after Electron Forge 8 issues ultimatum
BREAKING API
@unhappychoice manually patches feed-rs 3.0 breakage. Sources call it 'not fun'.
PEAK DETECTED
@unhappychoice logs 205 events on Wednesday alone. Doctors concerned.
